scenarios.name: Open customization from an expanded panel title

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title
the ribbon context menu is displayed
the Modify additional commands remain visible
the context menu offers "Customize User Commands"
the customization dialog opens on its Ribbon tab
the Modify additional command area is closed
the user closes the customization dialog without making changes
the dialog closes and the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
the Modify additional command area remains closed
